summary: Verified Text Alignment feature (Left/Center/Right) in the Edit Text floating rich-text toolbar for Iron Rabbit. All 16 acceptance criteria PASS. Alignment panel opens above the toolbar, applies ir-align-* class on nearest block ancestor (P/H1/H2/H3), preserves tag identity, preserves inline formatting (strong/em/u/s) and highlighter spans, toggles off on same-alignment re-tap, shows active-state ring on both the palette button and the toolbar entry, dismisses on overlay click, and persists through save -> close -> reopen (autosave to IndexedDB).

critical_code_review_comments: FloatingRichTextToolbar.jsx is very large (~3900 lines) — approaching the hard-split threshold; consider extracting AlignPanel, HighlightPanel, AaPanel and the active-state read helpers into separate files to improve maintainability.
ALIGN_CLASSES list is duplicated between applyAlign/readActiveAlign and the AlignPanel ALIGN_OPTIONS table — a single source of truth would reduce drift risk.
seed_data_creation: Used existing note 'T2' under Uncategorized tile; wrote various test HTMLs into its format editor during tests, final content kept by autosave: H1/H2/H3/P each with an ir-align-* class.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Text Alignment (ir-align-left/center/right) is working end-to-end on the FullScreenNote fs-content-editable + FloatingRichTextToolbar. Tested on desktop viewport 1280x900 which bypasses the mobile keyboard-up gate. Testids used: floating-rte-toolbar, floating-rte-btn-align, floating-rte-align-panel, floating-rte-align-overlay, floating-rte-align-left/center/right. Persistence verified by closing and reopening the note (autosave to IndexedDB wrote the sanitized HTML with the ir-align-* classes intact — htmlSanitize.js already allows class attribute). The AlignPanel renders as a portal to document.body and is positioned above the toolbar (panel bottom <= toolbar top). Both the palette button for the active direction AND the toolbar's Alignment entry light up with orange ring+bg when any ir-align-* class is present on the current block. Toggle semantics (tap the same alignment to clear) work correctly, including when the current alignment is left — class removes rather than reapplying.
